git_workflow.branch_workflow: Each build task uses a short-lived branch/worktree from green main, pushes the branch and opens a PR against main with gh pr create.
git_workflow.merge_policy: No direct pushes to main, no force-push, no self-merge of unreviewed work; independent Reviewer and Test-Engineer verification required; Integrator-only merges in dependency order.
git_workflow.control_plane: Feature branches append their own LOG/handoff files; the Orchestrator serializes STATE.md and TASKS.json changes and resolves control-plane conflicts before Integrator merge.

attempt_policy: Maximum four attempts per task; at attempt four pass all gates or stop and escalate to the Orchestrator. No fifth attempt is authorized.

dependency_satisfaction.implemented: Implementation and author-run tests exist on the task branch; branch artifacts may be consumed but the branch may not be merged.
dependency_satisfaction.independently_verified: Distinct trusted reviewer and tester sessions accepted the same commit/artifact with command logs; pre-merge acceptance is complete.
dependency_satisfaction.merged: The Integrator accepted pre-merge evidence, merged the PR into green main and recorded the merge SHA; consumers branch from this merged main.
dependency_satisfaction.recorded: A control/readiness task archived its structured result without a code-merge claim.

gate_policy: Full ARxx-Gn gates have exactly one final aggregator. Every gate/sub-gate result is validated against .harness/schemas/gate-results.schema.json; every staged aggregator invokes tools/gates/aggregate.py with all required sub-gate evidence. Missing, disabled, stale, failed or inconclusive evidence keeps the gate unpassed.
artifact_policy: Wheels and evidence bundles are stored under unique draft-release tags artifacts/<artifact-id> using authenticated gh. Tags/assets are append-only by policy, have no automatic expiry, and are accessible to later worktrees without public release. Every manifest binds source commit, Cargo.lock SHA-256, Rust toolchain, target/features and artifact SHA-256. Consumers fetch with gh release download and verify with tools/artifacts/store.py; ignored dist/ is never shared state.

review_model.identity_constraint: One GitHub identity is available; role separation is proved by an append-only Orchestrator-controlled session-role registry plus distinct session IDs, not GitHub approval metadata.
review_model.premerge: Build tasks complete at independently_verified; acceptance runs branch_gate.py --state independently_verified and session/verify_roles.py.
review_model.postmerge: After merge, the Integrator runs tools/ci/record_merge.py and writes evidence/<task-id>/merge.json; this record is required before dependent branches start.
review_model.proof_tasks: Every proof/verification task requires reviewer_evidence, test_evidence, session_registry_evidence and tools/review/verify_proof.py; self-certification is rejected.

artifact_store.upload: gh release create artifacts/<artifact-id> --draft --title <artifact-id> --notes <manifest-summary> && gh release upload artifacts/<artifact-id> <files>
artifact_store.retention: No automatic expiry; retain through Phase 1 evidence closure and any required audit/review period.
artifact_store.access: Authenticated swadhinbiswas account with repo scope; draft releases are not public.
artifact_store.immutability: Never reuse a tag, overwrite an asset, delete an artifact or rewrite its manifest; repairs create a new artifact-id.
